Selective Nerve Root Blocks

Persistent back or neck pain that radiates to the arms or legs can be difficult to manage without proper treatment. Selective Nerve Root Blocks provide a precise and effective solution to diagnose and relieve nerve-related pain. At Dr. Paradkar’s Ortho Cure and Pain Relief Clinic, we offer advanced Selective Nerve Root Blocks to reduce inflammation and target the exact source of pain without surgery.

This treatment is especially beneficial for conditions like sciatica, slipped disc, and nerve compression. With the expertise of a Non Surgical Orthopedic Doctor, patients receive accurate diagnosis and safe treatment. Our approach to Pain Management ensures faster recovery and long-lasting relief.

Benefits of Selective Nerve Root Blocks

Choosing the right treatment can significantly improve your comfort and mobility. Selective Nerve Root Blocks help reduce inflammation around the affected nerve, relieve radiating pain, and improve overall function. It is highly effective for patients suffering from chronic nerve pain and spinal conditions.

With advanced Pain Management, patients can experience relief without invasive surgery. Our focus on without surgery pain management ensures a safe and minimally invasive procedure. Treatment by a skilled Non Surgical Orthopedic Doctor leads to quicker healing and long-term benefits.

Why Choose Our Non Surgical Orthopedic Doctor?

Dr. Paradkar is a trusted Non Surgical Orthopedic Doctor known for his expertise in treating spine and nerve-related conditions. He specializes in without surgery pain management, offering precise and effective non-invasive treatments.

At our clinic, we focus on personalized care and advanced techniques. Our approach to Pain Management combines accurate diagnosis with targeted therapies to ensure optimal results. Patients choose Dr. Paradkar for his experience, patient-friendly approach, and commitment to long-term recovery.

Treatment Process & What to Expect

The procedure begins with a detailed evaluation of your condition. A targeted injection is administered near the affected nerve root to reduce inflammation and relieve pain. This minimally invasive procedure is quick, safe, and performed with precision.

With expert Pain Management in Kothrud, many patients experience immediate or gradual relief. Our emphasis on without surgery pain management ensures minimal discomfort and effective outcomes. Under the supervision of a qualified Non Surgical Orthopedic Doctor, the procedure remains safe and reliable.

If you are suffering from nerve-related pain, Selective Nerve Root Blocks in Kothrud can help you regain comfort and mobility. At Dr. Paradkar’s clinic, we provide advanced Selective Nerve Root Blocks designed for accurate diagnosis and long-term pain relief.
